searchText: Yeah this is normal because I launched my tool right after the testnet start to generate 100 million accounts 2 billion gas blocks is the expected size of those blocks lol <@!574864862338088960> our GetHashCode on the Address object was taking the first 4 bytes... since the accounts in the test code are all created with 0x00000000 at the beginning they all had the same hash code and our Dictionaries all had O(n) searches which was causing our sync to take 600x more time than it should so we synced over 2 days what I can syn now in 2 minutes took me a while to investigate... so this could only really be caused by a test code that uses 2 billion gas 🙂 Nice find!
